params.name: Mule 2076
params.note: CONCEPT, generated by scripts/shapes/concepts/mule-2076.mjs (edit that, not this). The Mule fifty years on, after the Electra.aero EL9 and the pilotless Caravans: the Twin Otter's strut-braced high wing lined with eight electric motors and five-blade props blowing full-span double-slotted flaps, vortex generators and raked winglets; a boxy freighter hull with a wraparound windscreen, eyebrow windows, crew doors, a side cargo door and a rear ramp under an upswept tail; a T-tail; a hydrogen turbogenerator in a dorsal nacelle with two cryogenic tanks on the crown beside it; a lidar nose, chin sensors and a satcom dome; tundra tyres on sponsons. A variant of the prop mesh, worn as the Mule 2076 factory edition.
